pairs.a: Run the full test suite before committing any change.
pairs.b: Before committing a change, run the whole test suite.

pairs.a: Give all measurements in metric units.
pairs.b: Use the metric system for every measurement you state.

pairs.a: Keep answers short and skip the preamble.
pairs.b: Respond concisely, without introductory filler.

pairs.a: Write dates in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).
pairs.b: Format every date as year-month-day, for example 2024-03-15.

pairs.a: Check that a file exists before trying to read it.
pairs.b: Before reading a file, check that it exists.

pairs.a: When an API returns HTTP 429, wait and retry with exponential backoff.
pairs.b: On a rate-limit response, back off with increasing delays before calling the API again.

pairs.a: This project installs JavaScript dependencies with pnpm.
pairs.b: Use pnpm, not npm or yarn, to add packages in this repository.

pairs.a: Add type hints to every new Python function.
pairs.b: Annotate parameters and return values with types whenever you write a Python function.

pairs.a: Ask for confirmation before deleting any files.
pairs.b: Never delete files without asking the user for confirmation first.

pairs.a: Cite the source document for every fact taken from the knowledge base.
pairs.b: When you use information from the knowledge base, name the document it came from.

pairs.a: Large model downloads can time out; resume them instead of restarting from zero.
pairs.b: If a big model download stalls or times out, continue the partial download rather than starting over.

pairs.a: Log timestamps in UTC.
pairs.b: Write log timestamps in UTC, never in local time.

pairs.a: Indent code with tabs.
pairs.b: Indent code with four spaces.

pairs.a: The user prefers a dark theme in generated UI mockups.
pairs.b: The user prefers a light theme in generated UI mockups.

pairs.a: Explain each step in detail when the user asks about the build process.
pairs.b: Give only the final command when the user asks about the build process.

pairs.a: Show prices in euros.
pairs.b: Show prices in US dollars.

pairs.a: Rebase feature branches onto main before merging.
pairs.b: Merge main into feature branches instead of rebasing them.

pairs.a: Run only the unit tests while iterating on a change.
pairs.b: Run the integration tests as well before handing a change over.

pairs.a: Format Python code with Black before committing.
pairs.b: Format Python code with Ruff before committing.

pairs.a: Schedule meetings in the Europe/Berlin time zone.
pairs.b: Schedule meetings in the America/New_York time zone.

pairs.a: Never run package installs with sudo on the build server.
pairs.b: Package installs on the build server must run with sudo.

pairs.a: Service configuration in this project lives in YAML files under config/.
pairs.b: Service configuration in this project comes from environment variables, not files.

pairs.a: Reply in English even when the user writes in another language.
pairs.b: Reply in whatever language the user writes in.

pairs.a: Use the Oxford comma in lists.
pairs.b: Leave out the serial comma before the final 'and' in lists.

pairs.a: Pin Docker base images to an exact version tag.
pairs.b: The user likes recipe suggestions that take under thirty minutes.

pairs.a: If the GPU runs out of memory, reduce the batch size before retrying.
pairs.b: End every summary of meeting notes with a list of action items.

pairs.a: Present comparisons of more than two options as a Markdown table.
pairs.b: The staging server reboots every Sunday night, so avoid deploying then.

pairs.a: Escape user input before inserting it into a regular expression.
pairs.b: The user prefers train connections over flights for trips within Europe.

pairs.a: Add a changelog entry for every user-visible change in this project.
pairs.b: When a web page fails to load, try an archived copy before giving up.

pairs.a: CSV exports for this team use semicolons as separators.
pairs.b: Close database connections in a finally block so they are never leaked.

pairs.a: Do not use emojis in replies.
pairs.b: Database migrations in this project are written by hand, never generated.

pairs.a: Label both axes and give every chart a title.
pairs.b: When a shell command fails with permission denied, check the file ownership first.

pairs.a: Name test methods after the behaviour they verify.
pairs.b: The user reads on a phone, so keep code lines in answers short.

pairs.a: Take a database backup before running a schema migration in production.
pairs.b: Translate technical terms for the user only when asked to.

pairs.a: Ignore lint warnings in generated files.
pairs.b: Round currency amounts to two decimal places in reports.

pairs.a: Use SSH keys, not passwords, to connect to the lab machines.
pairs.b: Write commit messages in the imperative mood.

pairs.a: Lege vor jedem Update eine Sicherung der Datenbank an.

pairs.a: Sprich den Nutzer immer mit „Sie“ an.
